name: Renting a Car
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on renting a car — practice these key phrases out loud:
I'd like to rent a car for the weekend.
Is there a fee for returning it at a different location?
Does it come with automatic or manual transmission?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
